_note: The course order: what NEW JOURNEY plays through, what the in-game level list offers, and the only place that knows how many levels the course has. Each id is godot/levels/<id>.json; a level file owns its own title and copy, so nothing is duplicated here. Finishing one loads the next.
_off_course: first_steps and proving_ground are the greybox tutorial and prototyping slices. They are deliberately NOT listed: the course is the themed Fractured Isles alone, and a new journey should not open on a greybox. Both level files are still shipped, still validated by scripts/check_levels.py, and First Steps is what the title screen's PRACTICE row boots — so dropping them from the order took them off the course, not out of the game. Putting either back is one line in `order`.
